name: Tradier
tagline: Brokerage API for market data, quotes, options chains, and live trading
description: Tradier provides a REST API for retail and developer brokerage: real-time and delayed market data, options chains/expirations, historical quotes, streaming via WebSocket/Socket.IO, account balances, positions, orders, and live equity/options trading on US markets. Sandbox (paper) and production endpoints are separate; authentication is Bearer access tokens from developer applications. Suitable for building trading bots, portfolio dashboards, options scanners, and market-data tools.

auth.details: Bearer access token in Authorization header (Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN). Create an app in the Tradier Developer portal (sandbox and/or production); token is issued per environment. OAuth-style account linking available for multi-user apps.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Sandbox free for development; production brokerage/API access requires a funded Tradier brokerage account—market-data and trading fees follow account/subscription plans (exact free request caps not published as a simple req/day free tier)
pricing.paid_plans: Brokerage commissions and optional market-data subscriptions; details on Tradier pricing and developer portal—confirm current tiers on site

rate_limits: not fully published as a single public table; some endpoints document practical limits—treat as account/plan-dependent; not published in aggregate
use_cases: get real-time or delayed stock quotes for symbols
fetch options chains and expirations for a ticker
place or cancel equity and options orders
list account balances, positions, and order history
stream market quotes or trade events over WebSocket
pull historical OHLCV bars for backtesting
